column1: # Every visible flag on every visible, runnable command of Astro CLI 1.x
# (main at 7aa23cdc), its own and those it inherits, the root's (--verbosity)
# and --help left out. One line per flag: the trees that had it, the command
# path without "astro", the flag, its shorthand, and bool when it took no
# value (string otherwise). The trees are 1.x's Astro tree for a non-hosted
# organization (astro) and a hosted one (astro-hosted), whose deployment
# create and update had flags of their own, and its APC tree (apc).
# It records 1.x, so nothing in v2 changes it. The CLI embeds it: a flag v2
# does not have is reported by what replaced it (removedFlags) only on a
# command this says had it. See removed_flags.go.
